title: Accounting Operations & Technical Accounting, Assistant Vice President
description: About the Role iCapital is seeking an experienced and versatile accounting professional to join the Corporate Finance team as an Accounting Operations and Technical Accounting Assistant Vice President. This role will support a broad range of accounting, financial reporting, controls, systems, tax-related initiatives, and special projects. The ideal candidate is a technically strong accountant with a hands-on, operational mindset who is comfortable moving between complex accounting matters and day-to-day execution.   Responsibilities Support technical accounting matters, including researching and applying U.S. GAAP and documenting conclusions for new and complex transactions. Support monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes across Corporate Finance, including accounting, preparing and reviewing account reconciliations and journal entries, and financial statement support. Assist with quarterly and annual financial reporting, financial statement disclosures, and external audit requests, including international audits and the 401(k) audit. Identify opportunities to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and scalability of close and reporting processes, including automation and process improvement across Corporate Finance. Assist with coordination and review of the Company's 409A valuation, stock-based compensation expense forecasting, and cash forecasting related to settlement of RSUs. Support the development, documentation, and execution of the Company's internal control framework, partnering with process owners to document accounting procedures and key controls. Assist with control testing, remediation, and preparation of supporting documentation, helping strengthen processes as iCapital continues to move toward public-company operating and reporting standards. Serve as a key administrator and business partner for finance systems, including FloQast and other accounting and reporting tools, maintaining system configurations, workflows, user access, and supporting documentation. Partner with Accounting, Finance, Tax, Legal, and other stakeholders on system implementations and enhancements. Support tax-related accounting and reporting processes, including coordinating information required for tax provision and compliance activities, and assist with employee and equity-related tax reporting as needed. Coordinate with internal Tax resources and external advisors on reporting requirements. Serve as a flexible resource for complex and cross-functional accounting initiatives, including new transactions, system implementations, process redesigns, acquisitions, and other strategic Finance projects, and take ownership of projects that may not fall cleanly within a traditional accounting function.   Qualifications 4-7 years of relevant accounting experience, with Big Four or other large public accounting experience is preferred Bachelor's degree in Accounting; CPA is strongly preferred Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial reporting Experience with internal controls, month-end close, and financial statement reporting Comfortable working with financial systems, large data sets and strong Excel skills Able to research technical accounting issues and translate conclusions into practical accounting processes Strong organizational and project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities Comfortable operating in a growing organization where responsibilities may evolve over time Technical experience researching an accounting issue and documenting the conclusion Operational experience booking entries, building reconciliations, improving controls, and managing systems Experience with SOX and internal controls   Benefits   The base salary range for this role is $ 110,000 to $ 140,000.  iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO). We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday. For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us    X: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc | Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us/recognition/ iCapital is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Manager, Financial Systems & Reporting Transformation
description: ABOUT THE ROLE The Senior Manager, Financial Systems & Reporting Transformation is responsible for leading the redesign of the company's financial master data — including the chart of accounts, cost centers, profit centers, product hierarchies, and dimensional reporting structures — with the objective of enhancing profitability insights, standardizing management reporting, and enabling seamless upstream consolidation with the parent company.  YOUR DAILY IMPACT AT PELOTON Lead the end-to-end redesign of the company's financial master data structures — chart of accounts, cost centers, profit centers, functional areas, internal orders, product hierarchies, customer/vendor master, and reporting dimensions — to enable enhanced profitability, channel, and product-level reporting Define the target-state data model required for seamless consolidation with the parent company's reporting environment, including alignment of GL accounts, entity structures, intercompany conventions, and dimensional hierarchies Develop and execute the migration plan from the legacy fragmented environment to the redesigned master data model, including data mapping, cleansing, cutover, and validation Establish master data governance (ownership, request/approval workflows, change controls, and audit trails) to preserve data integrity post-implementation Partner with IT and the SAP functional teams to configure and validate master data changes in SAP ECC, ensuring downstream impacts to sub-ledgers, allocations, and reporting are fully understood and controlled Spearhead process optimization efforts within key functional areas, including the month-end close process, consolidations, allocations, and monthly management reporting Drive efficiency and process design improvements within major transaction cycles: Order to Cash (OTC), Procure to Pay (PTP), Inventory, and Fixed Assets — with particular focus on how master data drives accuracy, controls, and reporting granularity Identify, champion, and execute opportunities to leverage IT solutions — SAP ECC configuration, reporting layers, and complementary tools — to create efficiencies and strengthen internal controls Collaborate directly with global and regional business leaders to drive actionable roadmaps for process simplification and automation, ensuring solutions are pragmatic and scalable Serve as the lead point of contact for financial data alignment with the parent company, ensuring the redesigned master data supports consolidated reporting, elimination entries, and management-view analytics Partner with the parent company's controllership and FP&A teams to define mapping rules, submission cadences, and data quality standards Support the design of the future-state consolidation process, including any tooling, mapping tables, or reporting bridges required to reconcile local and consolidated views YOU BRING TO PELOTON BA/BS degree in Accounting/Finance or related field CPA preferred (or equivalent) 8+ years of relevant experience in accounting, finance transformation, or reporting at a public company and/or external audit of public companies. Public company experience is required Hands-on SAP ECC experience is required, including a working knowledge of the FI/CO module, master data structures (chart of accounts, cost centers, profit centers, internal orders), and how master data drives sub-ledger and reporting outcomes Demonstrated experience leading or contributing to a financial master data redesign, chart of accounts redesign, or ERP finance transformation program Experience or strong familiarity with AI/LLM-enabled finance tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT/Claude for data analysis, or AI-driven reconciliation modules inside major ERPs/EPMs) Experience supporting or enabling consolidations into a parent company's reporting environment, including intercompany, elimination, and mapping conventions Previous participation in existing internal control programs; strong understanding of SOX implications of master data and system changes Data analytics experience preferred; comfort working with large data sets and reporting tools to validate and communicate the impact of master data changes Project management skills — effective consultation, interpersonal, prioritization of topics/issues, and organization. Experience leading cross-functional transformation workstreams is strongly preferred Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical data model decisions into business-relevant impacts Must be a highly organized, detail-oriented self-starter with the ability to work independently and within a team environment Ability to work effectively with all levels of an organization, from analyst to executive, and across accounting, IT, FP&A, and parent-company stakeholders An objective, independent, mature, unbiased individual with the highest integrity Superior problem-solving skills and ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines A

title: Compliance Lead, Testing
description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. About the Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team  The Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team is a group of dedicated professionals committed to helping Affirm scale, innovate, and provide outstanding products for consumers, merchants, and key partners. We combine legal, compliance, and policy expertise to guide growth, shape products, and build trust across our ecosystem. Our work spans multiple professional disciplines and provides the foundation for Affirm’s mission to deliver honest financial products. About the role Affirm’s Compliance team implements a compliance program that enables Affirm to proactively adhere to regulatory requirements while also identifying and addressing potential regulatory issues that may arise. As a second line of defense, Compliance proactively partners with the business to support new products, markets, initiatives, change management, issue identification and remediation plans, and assessment/monitoring of third parties. Affirm is actively seeking a Compliance Lead to support certain critical compliance management program elements. In this role, the Compliance Lead will help to administer Compliance’s Testing Program. This includes completing reviews to ensure compliance with federal/state regulations, identifying gaps and deficiencies with regulatory compliance concerns, collaborate with cross functional partners including Legal, Operations, Product, Engineering and senior management to resolve identified issues and further build out our compliance program. This role will report to the Senior Compliance Manager and will be required to work independently and cross-functionally. What you'll do Perform ongoing compliance testing and reporting on adherence to compliance program and federal/state regulatory requirements. Work closely and cross-functionally with multiple departments (Compliance, Legal, Risk, Product, etc.) while completing reviews. Support a very fast paced business with tight deadlines while providing diligent and detailed work product. Collaborate with management to identify improvements to current processes or propose new processes to strengthen internal controls. Coordinate the execution of the compliance risk assessment and control inventory, including collecting and documenting results. Serve as an expert in the area of regulatory compliance and how it applies to new and/or revised products and services. Continuously improve internal compliance processes relating to the Compliance Testing Program. What we look for 5+ years of professional work experience in Compliance Testing, or Audit. Knowledge of applicable laws, regulations, financial services, and regulatory trends that impact Affirm’s business. Experience in completing end-to-end compliance testing activities. Strong communication and relationship management skills. Inquisitive and proactive in proposing creative and effective solutions and ability to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment. Strong project management, critical thinking and analytical skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly present complex and sensitive issues. Proficient computer navigation skills using a variety of software packages, including Google docs, word processing, spreadsheets, and presentations. Must be detail oriented, thorough, and well organized. Base Pay Grade - J Equity Grade - 5 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.) USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $130,000 - $180,000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $115,000 - $165,000 Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. #LI-Remote Remote-first with flexibility built in Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience. Benefits designed for you Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility.
